payload.text: The expiry-cut region is decided by the QUOTE currency (docs/CONVENTIONS.md Cut → New York 10:00 vs Tokyo 15:00). `region_of(pair)` is a pure total function returning Region::Tokyo exactly when pair.quote == Ccy::JPY, else Region::NewYork — the JPY-region/Asian business books the Tokyo 15:00 cut, every other pair the New York 10:00 cut. It keys on the quote leg only (the JPY pairs are quoted XXXJPY), so the region/cut is a deterministic function of the pair, never of spot or tenor. const-foldable, no writes/allocation/IO. Self-invalidates if the region-selection rule or Region/Ccy variant set changes (WRITES gate).
